## 90 · dev test harness (not part of the product)

`POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/salon-tool`
```json
{ "tool": "chat", "input": { "user_key": "telegram:demo", "text": "do you do rebonding?" } }
```

Fires the real sub-workflow through Execute Workflow, so what you get back is exactly what the phase-2 agent will get. `scripts/verify-tools.sh` drives every AC through this endpoint.

Deactivate it before any public deployment — it is an unauthenticated trigger.
